sv.title: Anthropic faller tungt i förhandeln
sv.summary: Anthropic rusade under sin premiärdag på Wall Street – men i fredagens förhandel vänder kursen ned tydligt. ”Det som såg ut att vara den sista pelaren som höll AI-rallyt uppe verkar nu också ge vika”, säger en investeringschef till Bloomberg.

en.title: Anthropic falls sharply in trading
en.summary: Anthropic surged on Wall Street on its debut day – but in Friday's trading the share price turns clearly downward. "What appeared to be the last pillar holding up the AI rally now also seems to be giving way," an investment chief tells Bloomberg.
